description: traceability matrix and component contract coverage omit FR-JOU-02 even though the technical specification claims to cover it. The journal component does not trace to an explicit edit operation or update interface
reason: The developer cannot verify that same-day journal editing is implemented or estimate the work needed. - Added in the requirement to the traceability section and the component section as it is the only Should functional requirement

description: AI interface requires prompt check_ins and journal_entries but does not define the permitted prompt values or the request schema for individual records
reason: The developer cannot implement deterministic request validation or reject unapproved prompt types consistently - Did not need to add this as it was already determined that the prompt would be a predetermined prompt and the check ins and journal entries will be selected by the stressed individual so it is possible to implement validation and consistenty in rejections

description: the specification also permits a retry after validator failure without explaining how the retry fits within the deadline
reason: The developer cannot determine how to implement retries and fallback while meeting the response-time requirements - Added in more clarifying information to show that the retry uses the same times as call and request time limits

description: The contract specifies HTTP 500 ai_service_error but does not clarify whether a successful keyword-based fallback returns HTTP 200 or HTTP 500
reason: The client cannot reliably distinguish a usable fallback result from a failed request - Added in a message to state that when the fallback is used that a message will appear stating the request failed but the fallback is returning a response

description: Error logging is required but the fields to log are not defined and there is no explicit rule prohibiting sensitive journal or check-in content from being logged
reason: The developer cannot implement and verify diagnostic logging without uncertainty about privacy boundaries - Added in a note to clarify what exactly is logged when any error happens logging the type of error when it happened and what request caused it

description: Fields such as physical_stress_location, physical_symptoms and stress_cause have enumerated choices but the data model does not establish whether users can select multiple choices
reason: The developer cannot determine whether the database must preserve multiple answers for these questions - Added in a note to clarify for all enum fields multiple can be clicked and stored

description: hours_slept water_consumed and stress_duration lack clearly specified units acceptable ranges and validation rules
reason: The developer cannot implement consistent input validation or reliably handle invalid values - Added in the ranges in which the 3 fields could range from so that they can be properly checked

description: Dates are stored in UTC, but the specification does not define the timezone policy for assigning records to calendar days weeks and months in the overview graphs
reason: The developer cannot consistently group records at day week or month boundaries - Added some clarifying information to state how the time is stored and displayed based on the stressed individuals timezone and then the check in are grouped based on their week/month before displaying

description: Journal entries are required to be nonblank, but the lifecycle says that a blank edit hard-deletes an entry. It does not clarify whether a blank edit should be rejected or delete the existing entry
reason: The developer must make an unsupported decision about whether editing a journal entry can destroy saved data - Nothing needed to be added as it stated something was missing clarification that already was written down clarified to what was necessary

description: The AI flow says to select records but the interface contract does not define record identifiers or how selected records are resolved into the request arrays
reason: The developer cannot implement the selection-to-request process precisely from the specification - There has already been clairfication added for how the user is the one that selects the check ins and journal entries and those are the ones taken from SQLite and used in the request

description: The flow sends selected records from the client to the Edge Function but the contract does not explain how the function verifies that only the records selected by the user are included
reason: The developer cannot establish or verify the intended privacy boundary for data sent for AI analysis - There has already been statements added for how the user is the one that selects the check ins and journal entries and those are the only ones used in the request

description: The flow says the app updates the overview graphs after a check-in, but does not define the read/query behavior for refreshing the graphs or how a refresh failure is handled
reason: The developer cannot verify that the graph-update timing requirement is met or that failures are handled consistently - Had clarified everything but needed to add how if the graphs could not update then to show the past graphs with a message stating the graphs could not update

description: The response schema requires both analysis_explanation and activity_suggestion but does not define what each field should contain when the user requests only one type of analysis
reason: The developer cannot determine whether both fields must always contain meaningful content or whether one can be empty - Added a note to clarify what is returned in the response based on the prompt picked where if just either the analysis_explanation or the activity_suggestion is required to be return based on the prompt picked then the response not returned/required to be returned returns with no suggested explanation or activity requested

description: The specification says local records are deleted when the app is deleted but does not define how backups or exported copies affect the deletion and retention behavior
reason: The developer cannot establish the full data-retention and deletion behavior from the design - There are no backups or copies needed or wanted the data is gone when deleted no matter when the app is deleted this has been stated

description: The API defines a 404 not_found response for missing records but the records live in local SQLite and the Edge Function receives them from the client. It is unclear where the server would check whether a record exists
reason: The developer cannot identify a defined source of truth for this error condition - I removed the error 404 because I realized that the Edge Function could not itself verify if they can be found or not

description: Some enumerated choice lists including those for physical location symptoms and stress cause appear incomplete or end with a trailing
reason: The developer cannot implement exhaustive validation without guessing the intended choices - The amount of choices lin the enum lists provide a good range to individuals and it won't be hard to add in a few more choices later if they are really necessary but right not they are the best I can think of so no more right now is needed

description: The requirement calls for a prompt about potentially unsaved journal data after a crash but the design does not define how unsaved drafts are persisted or recovered
reason: The developer cannot implement the required crash-recovery behavior without deciding how unsaved journal content survives an app failure - I have never stated that a journal entry will be saved after a crash only mentioned that a message will appear if the app crashes stating the text might not have been saved
